title: Quinquelobate
summary: QUIN'QUELOBATE, QUIN'QUELOBED, adjective [Latin quinque, five, and lobus, lobe.] Five-lobed; divided to the middle into five distinct parts with convex margins.

inlines.v: QUIN'QUELOBATE, QUIN'QUELOBED, adjective [Latin quinque, five, and lobus, lobe.] Five-lobed; divided to the middle into five distinct parts with convex margins.
